scenarios.why: Generated by lab/cmd/xmageport from XMage InfiniteReflectionTest#testCopyAsEnters.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[static-true-changeszone-trigger-on-stack]: Infinite Reflection's Static$ True ChangesZone trigger (RememberInitialAttach) is queued as an ordinary stacked trigger and offered in a trigger_order with TrigClone; ordered first it resolves last, so TrigClone resolves with an empty Remembered set, Silvercoat Lion stops being a creature/dies and Reflection goes to the graveyard (probe: Lion and Reflection in graveyard, Ox not a copy). checkFaceTriggers queues every matching T: line and only Attached/RolledDie matchers honour Static$ True (engine/rules/trigger_match.go:1147; engine/rules/trigmatch/actions.go:179,561). Static$ True lines must apply immediately, not use the stack. CR 603.3 (only real triggered abilities are put on the stack; Forge Static$ True lines are rules-engine bookkeeping that must apply immediately).
